title: Upper Extremity Kinematics During Walking
brief_summary: Our aim is to investigate the upper extremity kinematics during walking in healthy individuals.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Between the ages of 20 and 40 years individuals
* Without any medical condition that would affect gait or arm swing

Exclusion Criteria:

* People with upper or lower limb asymmetry
study_population: Healthy individuals in the age of 20-40 years
